name: bino
description: Maritime perception sensor emulator for V&V

scripts.kernels:build: cd kernels && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target bundler --out-dir ../packages/core/wasm --out-name radar target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/bino_radar.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target bundler --out-dir ../packages/core/wasm --out-name lidar target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/bino_lidar.wasm
scripts.validate:scenarios: cd packages/node && npx vitest run test/scenarios.test.ts
